form.label: Databricks Security - Live activity
form.description: Near real-time security activity across Databricks workspaces, read from system.access.audit when the dashboard refreshes (every 5m; audit events arrive about 10 minutes after they happen). Click an actor to filter on it. Source: the live_* views of the Databricks Security Posture bundle.

search.query: | makeresults | addinfo | eval t_to=floor(if(isnum(info_max_time) AND info_max_time < now(), info_max_time, now())) | eval t_from=floor(max(info_min_time, now() - 90 * 86400)), range=t_to - t_from | eval t_span=case(range <= 7200, 60, range <= 43200, 300, range <= 172800, 900, range <= 691200, 3600, true(), 86400) | eval t_span_label=case(t_span == 60, "1m", t_span == 300, "5m", t_span == 900, "15m", t_span == 3600, "1h", true(), "1d")
| makeresults | eval v=$actor|s$ | eval v=if(len(trim(v)) == 0, "%", replace(replace(v, "['\"\\\\]", ""), "\*", "%"))

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT floor(unix_timestamp(event_time) / $t_span$) * $t_span$ AS bucket, category, signal, count(*) AS events, max(unix_timestamp(event_time)) AS last_event FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') AND signal IN ($signals$) GROUP BY ALL"

| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT max(unix_timestamp(event_time)) AS newest FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= current_date() - 1 AND event_time >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 DAY"
| databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT DISTINCT workspace_name FROM $sp$.workspaces WHERE workspace_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1"
| stats count as n, sum(events) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| stats count as n, sum(eval(if(signal="HIGH", events, 0))) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| stats count as n, sum(eval(if(category="Authentication failure", events, 0))) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| stats count as n, sum(eval(if(category="IP access blocked", events, 0))) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| stats count as n, sum(eval(if(category="Identity & admin", events, 0))) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| stats count as n, sum(eval(if(category="Data export", events, 0))) as v | fillnull value=0 v | fields v
| eval v=round((now() - tonumber(newest)) / 60) | fields v

single.option: minutes since the newest audit event

panel.title: Security events over time by category

search.query: | eval _time=tonumber(bucket) | timechart span=$t_span_label$ sum(events) by category limit=15 useother=f
| stats sum(events) as events by category signal | xyseries category signal events | fillnull value=0 | table category HIGH MEDIUM INFO

panel.title: HIGH signals - act now
panel.description: Admin rights granted, PAT without expiry, high privilege granted to all users, IP access list deleted, ABAC policy deleted, open-sharing token retrieved. Ignores the signal filter.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(event_time) AS epoch, workspace_name, category, actor, action_name, target, detail, source_ip FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') AND signal = 'HIGH' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200" | eval _time=tonumber(epoch) | fields - epoch | eval detail=substr(detail, 1, 160)

table.fields: _time, workspace_name, category, actor, action_name, target, detail, source_ip

panel.title: Latest security events
panel.description: Most recent 500 events matching the filters. Click an actor to investigate it.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT unix_timestamp(event_time) AS epoch, signal, category, workspace_name, actor, action_name, target, detail, source_ip, status_code FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') AND signal IN ($signals$) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 500" | eval _time=tonumber(epoch) | fields - epoch | eval detail=substr(detail, 1, 160)

table.fields: _time, signal, category, workspace_name, actor, action_name, target, detail, source_ip, status_code

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT actor, count_if(signal = 'HIGH') AS high, count_if(signal = 'MEDIUM') AS medium, count(*) AS events, array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(category)), 1, 6), ', ') AS categories, count(DISTINCT workspace_name) AS workspaces, max(unix_timestamp(event_time)) AS last_seen FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') AND signal IN ($signals$) AND actor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY actor ORDER BY high DESC, medium DESC, events DESC LIMIT 15" | eval last_seen=strftime(tonumber(last_seen), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

table.fields: actor, high, medium, events, categories, workspaces, last_seen

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT source_ip, count(*) AS failures, count_if(category = 'IP access blocked') AS ip_blocks, count(DISTINCT actor) AS principals, array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(actor)), 1, 5), ', ') AS sample_principals, array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(detail)), 1, 3), ' | ') AS errors FROM $sp$.live_security_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(actor, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') AND category IN ('Authentication failure', 'IP access blocked') GROUP BY source_ip ORDER BY failures DESC LIMIT 15"

table.fields: source_ip, failures, ip_blocks, principals, sample_principals, errors

panel.title: Denied data access
panel.description: Unity Catalog / SQL requests refused (401 / 403): bursts suggest probing or missing grants.

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT principal, count(*) AS attempts, count(DISTINCT securable_name) AS securables, array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(securable_name)), 1, 5), ', ') AS sample_securables, array_join(slice(array_sort(collect_set(action_name)), 1, 4), ', ') AS actions, max(unix_timestamp(event_time)) AS last_attempt FROM $sp$.live_access_denied_events WHERE event_date >= CAST(timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AS DATE) AND event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') AND lower(coalesce(principal, '')) LIKE lower('$actor_like$') GROUP BY principal ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 15" | eval last_attempt=strftime(tonumber(last_attempt), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

table.fields: principal, attempts, securables, sample_securables, actions, last_attempt

panel.title: Network policy denials
panel.description: Context-based ingress and serverless egress denials (empty if these system tables are not enabled).

search.query: | databricksquery account_name="$dbx_account$" $dbx_warehouse$ command_timeout=300 query="SELECT direction, target, outcome, count(*) AS denials, count(DISTINCT source_ip) AS source_ips, count(DISTINCT workspace_name) AS workspaces FROM $sp$.live_network_denials WHERE event_time >= timestamp_seconds($t_from$) AND event_time < timestamp_seconds($t_to$) AND ('$ws$' = '*' OR workspace_name = '$ws$') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY denials DESC LIMIT 15"

table.fields: direction, target, outcome, denials, source_ips, workspaces
